mapper.select: select r.id, r.order_id as orderId, o.title as orderTitle, sk.name as skillerName, r.score, r.content, r.tags, r.is_anonymous as isAnonymous, r.create_time as createTime from order_review r left join orders o on r.order_id = o.id left join skiller sk on r.runner_id = sk.id where r.user_id = #{userId} order by r.create_time desc, r.id desc
